metadata.description: Capsule's collection of Claude plugins. Designed in-house for AI label compliance and competitive intelligence workflows.

plugins.name: competitive-audit
plugins.description: Designed by Capsule. Produces a professionally formatted Word competitive audit of a client's product against their market. Accepts a live website URL, an uploaded document (PDF / Word / PowerPoint / text), or both. Identifies the competitor set across four pricing tiers, runs per-competitor research, and builds a styled docx with executive summary, pricing comparison, feature matrix, wins/parity/gaps analysis, and prioritized recommendations (Trust / Product / Pricing / GTM).

plugins.name: ebillity-timesheet
plugins.description: Designed by Capsule. Manages time in eBillity TimeTracker by driving Chrome: log hours to a job/day/service item, run a live timer, answer questions about recorded time, check if a week is ready to submit, fix rejected time, and submit or approve only on explicit request. Never types passwords and never submits, approves, or deletes on its own initiative.

plugins.name: capsule-estimator
plugins.description: Designed by Capsule. Turns a proposal scope into a grounded, range-based estimate — hours and price by discipline — built from Capsule's own signed history (the Proposals Index, Pricing Reference, and Discipline Hours Benchmark in Notion). Cites the nearest comparable past jobs, carries a confidence label on every number, and applies Capsule's win-rate guardrails (the $50K line, the 3-discipline rule). Needs the Notion connector.

plugins.name: ship-plugin
plugins.description: Designed by Capsule. Ship a Capsule skill as a Claude Code plugin in one step — scaffold it, version it, publish it to the capsule-plugins marketplace, and install it on both Macs. Use when the user says "make this a plugin", "ship this skill", "publish this as a plugin", "release the <name> plugin", "add <name> to the marketplace", or wants a SKILL.md turned into an installed, synced plugin. Runs from ~/CapsulePlugins using add-plugin.sh, release.sh, and the claude plugin CLI (needs shell access + SSH to the Mac Studio).
